pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions within 15 minutes or 2.00 points of a prior losing execution; multi-ticket entries into falling/rising momentum wicks are permanently disabled.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No order execution authorized unless order book imbalance exceeds 72% and spread is under 35 pips with zero high-impact Tier-1 USD/XAU news scheduled in the next 15 minutes.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively secure profits when open trade equity hits +$15.00 using trailing micro-steps, strictly preventing wins from decaying back to breakeven or minor losses.
